title: Completion naturality from a strict tensor tower square
statement: For any map s of ordinary total tensors and any map a of the associated strict finite tensor towers, if the scalar-extended s intertwines the two tensor-tower comparison maps with a, then s intertwines the two completion chains with Roos(a). This is conditional naturality for an arbitrary strict square, with no sign or braiding assertion.

source.place: Paragraph 3, strict quotient augmentation; Bhatt--Scholze 3.4.10 and 6.5.5; Stacks 08TC

proof.text: Identify completionChain with the native tensorCompletionChain. Expand its component as roosUnit followed by Roos of tensorTowerIso. Naturality of roosUnit and the functor map-composition law turn the assumed strict tower square into the completion-chain square.

theorem completion_natural_of_tower_square
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ)
    (s : (constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (P, Q) ⟶
      (constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (Q, P))
    (a : (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E X).obj (P, Q) ⟶
      (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E X).obj (Q, P))
    (ha : (IntegralOnSlice.tower l E X none).map s ≫
        (IntegralAmbient.tensorTowerIso l E X).hom.app (Q, P) =
      (IntegralAmbient.tensorTowerIso l E X).hom.app (P, Q) ≫ a) :
    s ≫ (completionChain D l hl X E).app (Q, P) =
      (completionChain D l hl X E).app (P, Q) ≫ integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map a
